_readme: Edit this file to add or update apps. downloadUrl should point to an APK attached to a GitHub Release, e.g. https://github.com/Arkan17/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<file>.apk. Leave it empty to show 'Coming soon'. icon and screenshots can be image paths/URLs; leave them empty to use generated placeholders.

apps.name: Ummati
apps.tagline: An App That Every Muslim Needs
apps.description:
Ummati is your all-in-one Islamic companion, thoughtfully designed to make everyday Islamic practices easier and keep you connected with your faith. From reading the Holy Quran and finding the Qibla direction to tracking your daily Dhikr with Digital Tasbih, checking accurate prayer times and discovering nearby mosques, Ummati brings essential Islamic tools together in one convenient place.

Whether you are at home, travelling or on the go, Ummati helps you stay connected to your Islamic routine and strengthen your spiritual journey.

One app. Everything you need for your daily Islamic life.

**Ummati – Your Faith, Always With You.**
features: Holy Quran – Read and explore the Holy Quran
Qibla Compass – Find the direction of the Holy Kaaba
Digital Tasbih – Keep track of your daily Dhikr
Prayer Times – Stay updated with daily Salah timings
Islamic Tools – Essential features for everyday Muslim life
apps.changelog:
Initial Release of Ummati!

- Introducing your all-in-one Islamic companion.
- Access the Holy Quran anytime.
- Find the Qibla direction with ease.
- Keep track of your Dhikr using Digital Tasbih.
- Check daily prayer timings.
- Discover nearby mosques.
- Enjoy a simple and user-friendly experience.

More features and improvements coming soon, In Sha Allah!

apps.name: Tutoza
apps.tagline: Run your tuition from your phone
apps.description:
Tutoza helps private tuition teachers in India manage batches, attendance, tests, fees and parent updates in one simple app.

Students and parents join free, with no ads. Parents pay fees straight to the teacher by UPI, and Tutoza takes no commission.

Website: https://tutoza.expo.app
features: Batches & students with digital ID cards (QR)
Attendance in seconds, with an instant absent alert to parents
Tests, marks and monthly PDF report cards
Fees tracking, WhatsApp reminders and UPI payment
Notes, notices and chat with families
Separate views for teachers, parents and students
apps.changelog:
• Photos are compressed before upload — notes load faster and use less data
• Notes you've opened once now open instantly, even offline
• Chat: loads the latest messages first, with "Load earlier messages"
• Better security for accounts and join codes
